title: Quiz: Objects and Structures
description: Check your understanding of Objects and Structures.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Dart?
questions.explanation: In Dart, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does an object/struct primarily do?
options: Groups related data (and often behavior) under one name
questions.correctAnswer: Groups related data (and often behavior) under one name
questions.explanation: Objects model real-world things with fields + methods.

questions.question: True or False: You can access object fields using dot notation or bracket notation in many languages.
Fill in the blank: user.${field}  // access a field
questions.explanation: Dot notation reaches into an object.

questions.question: In Dart, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
